problem: Personal user upload photos were misclassified as the Mira identity reference, causing generated Mira media to depict the user.
root_cause: The media generator trusted an upload label/history without a canonical identity-reference contract and without proving the selected reference belonged to the fictional Mira lineage.
prevention: Require one canonical fictional Mira master reference in every media job and reject known user-upload reference IDs before verification or publication.
